GOT QUESTIONS?

Health Insurance FAQ

Clear guidance on deductibles, networks, prescription formularies, and enrollment periods.

A PPO (Preferred Provider Organization) gives you the freedom to see any doctor or specialist without requiring a referral from a primary care physician, and offers coverage for both in-network and out-of-network care. An HMO (Health Maintenance Organization) requires you to choose a primary care doctor and get referrals for specialists, and typically covers only in-network providers.
Yes. All our ACA-compliant individual and family health insurance plans provide comprehensive coverage for pre-existing conditions from day one with zero waiting periods.
When enrolled in an HSA-qualified High Deductible Health Plan, you can contribute tax-deductible dollars to a dedicated HSA account. Those funds roll over year after year, can be invested, and can be withdrawn completely tax-free for medical, dental, and vision expenses.
You can enroll during the annual Open Enrollment period or at any time during the year if you qualify for a Special Enrollment Period due to a life event such as changing jobs, moving, marriage, or the birth of a child.
Emergency medical care is covered nationwide at in-network cost-sharing levels regardless of where you are in the United States. Additionally, our 24/7 virtual telehealth service is available anywhere across all 50 states.
